stem: Which sentence best supports the idea that more than one language is spoken in La Gomera?

options.label: A
options.text: Whistling allowed islanders to deliver messages across the ravines without having to walk great distances around them. (paragraph 4)

options.label: B
options.text: The whistles were often used to make public announcements or to send invitations to events. (paragraph 4)

options.label: C
options.text: It is far from being the common language that it used to be. (paragraph 5)
